name: Love Lab ~Choukyou Nante Kyoumi no Nakatta Ore to Kanojo no Houkago SM Laboratory~
original_name: らぶらぼ～調教なんて興味のなかった俺と彼女の放課後SMラボラトリー～
source:
Souichirou is a sheltered boy from a rich family, living in a quiet town outside of the city. Then one day, he discovered that his father had gone missing after a failed venture in an African diamond mine and left him penniless. Since his father had aided the acting school chairwoman Saki many times, she let Souichirou stay in the janitor’s room if he worked as the school custodian. With no other relatives to depend upon, he had no choice but to accept these humiliating conditions.

Ordered around daily by his former classmates, he wished to run away but was bound by his financial situation. That’s when Saki revealed to him that she likes SM and would like him to help her out. So begins his new school life of humble caretaker by day and new master by night.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/06/06/june-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
宗一郎出身富裕家庭，在远离都市的宁静小镇过着备受呵护的生活。某天，他得知父亲投资非洲钻石矿失败后失踪，自己也因此身无分文。由于父亲过去曾多次帮助学校的代理理事长真岛咲，她同意让宗一郎住进传达室，条件是由他担任学校勤杂员。宗一郎已没有其他亲人可以依靠，只能接受这份屈辱的安排。

昔日同学每天对他呼来喝去，他虽想逃离，却受困于窘迫的经济状况。就在这时，真岛咲向他坦白，自己喜欢SM，希望他能陪自己实践。于是，他开始了白天卑微地打杂、夜晚化身新任主人的校园生活。

[引自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/06/06/june-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
